verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs reference risk-adjacent capabilities like Enhanced Due Diligence, Customer Risk Rating, and case notifications for high-risk customers/accounts, implying some operational risk tooling exists, but there is no concrete evidence of configurable transaction or velocity limits, suspicious-activity holds, or account freeze/reinstatement workflows. missing for 10: documentation of per-account/program transaction and velocity limit configuration, evidence of hold placement on suspicious activity, and documented account freeze and reinstatement procedures.
